Would it make sense to change the version policy to require exact match since this is H3 test?

> Would it make sense to change the version policy to require exact match since this is H3 test?

We have two different tests for H/3 interop, one testing exact version: 
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/f9999cc1aaa2be9fdc81e69f78c3771e6106d93c/src/libraries/System.Net.Http/tests/FunctionalTests/HttpClientHandlerTest.Http3.cs#L559

And this one, testing Alt-Svc upgrade. So we do 2 requests, one for H/1/2 and following for H/3 on the same client. What failed here is the first request since that particular endpoint stopped supporting lower than H/3 versions. And since we're using the same endpoint list for both tests, I kept the endpoint there but handled it with a catch block.

> Would it make sense to change the version policy to require exact match since this is H3 test?

There's already a separate test with exact match, I believe?
